notes: Tuning page: added a Tip Charger USB dropdown. When more than one Tip Charger is plugged in (auto-connect won't guess between them), pick the one you want from the list - it shows each port with its adapter description - and press Connect; a Rescan button refreshes the list, and it shows the connected port and whether it is live. Builds on the fixed OTA updater from 1.0.61.
